description: SORT/MERGE COLLATING SEQUENCE national surface - alphabet-name-2 of the IS form and the FOR ALPHANUMERIC / FOR NATIONAL forms (ISO 14.9.40.2 / 14.9.24.2), a 2002 introduction with the national class. ACTIVE as of P10 Step 4: the phrase parses at every edition (superset), the gate fires on recognition (VisitSortCollatingPhrase), and the binder resolves + class-validates alphabet-name-2 against the FOR NATIONAL alphabet registry (14.9.40.3 SR2); national KEYS still cannot exist (D-N2 refuses national leaves in SD records; the table-sort national key stages loud), so the validated sequence has no reachable key consumer yet.
citation: ISO §2023:14.9.40.3 SR2 (alphabet-name-2 orders NATIONAL keys; the national class is 2002+)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. RWSCN.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
CONFIGURATION SECTION.
SPECIAL-NAMES.
    ALPHABET A1 IS STANDARD-1
    ALPHABET A2 FOR NATIONAL IS NATIVE.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT S-F ASSIGN TO "rwscn.tmp".
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
SD S-F.
01 S-REC PIC X(5).
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 W-REC PIC X(5).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    SORT S-F ON ASCENDING KEY S-REC
        COLLATING SEQUENCE A1 A2
        INPUT PROCEDURE IS IP
        OUTPUT PROCEDURE IS OP.
    STOP RUN.
IP.
    RELEASE S-REC FROM W-REC.
OP.
    RETURN S-F INTO W-REC AT END CONTINUE END-RETURN.
